calibration_data: Exactly the original 1200 training trajectories, no extra observations
selection: Uniform valid starts and targets in [0.08,0.92]^2 outside bumper+target radius; separation >=0.30. No selection by success or model error.
knowledge: Contact-repair and calibrated controllers know position integration, table geometry and contact structure. Drag and restitution are fitted from training observations. Oracle directly uses simulator dynamics and is a privileged feasibility baseline, not an ML repair.
decision: Freeze fitting and controller definitions before running confirmation. Report success counts, per-scene regressions, Wilson intervals and timing; do not select seeds or retune after confirmation.
